title: Spa booking system down (Seaside Resort Danang)
description: The property's spa reservation system is unreachable; guests cannot be booked for treatments.
problemDescription: Hệ thống đặt spa không truy cập được. Spa booking app offline, cannot load appointments.
prerequisites: Employee is at the spa reception
Employee can see the spa booking terminal
expectedResult: Spa booking system is reachable and appointments can be created.
failureCondition: After all steps the spa system remains unreachable.
escalationCondition: Suspected network/app fault or steps exhausted without resolution.

steps.instruction: Is the spa terminal powered on and showing the booking app (not a network error)?
Check the terminal's network/Wi-Fi and restart the spa booking app. Does it load now?
Try creating a test appointment. Does it save?
Great — the spa system is back. Continue with the guest's booking.
